profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SCT Software
profile.summary: .NET Senior developer based on the Washington DC metro area, with a passion for code quality and test automation.

positions.title: Lead Consultant
positions.description:
•  Luis became the leading SME on Automated Testing on the account, where he took charge of
maintaining and expanding our current testing pipelines, upgrading front-end tests from
Selenium to Cypress, and expanding the capabilities of our Specflow Integration tests on
Gherkin syntax to include external systems, while reducing the run times on more than half.

•  Co-led the Employment Data Refactor project, a yearlong project to port dozens of
database tables to a more structured format, while those tables were actively being used
in production, and with zero outages for our users.

•  Luis was a strong collaborator on the most challenging technical initiatives on the account, such
as upgrading our monolith application from .NET Framework to .NET Core, and then .NET
5; upgrading EF to EF Core; upgrading our Front-End JavaScript libraries from Backbone,
AngularJS and jQuery to Angular 13; and implementing Octopus pipelines for automated
deployments

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Luis joined Excella and was placed as a Programing Consultant to Excella's largest non-profit sector account.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Credible Behavioral Health Software (later merged into by Qualifacts)

As  part  of  a  team,  created  the  new  Client  Portal  web  app,  to  allow  clients  and  designees  to  access  health  records  on  a  user  friendly  manner;  eventually  becoming  the  technical  point  of  contact  for  the  app.    

Developed  the  front-end  of  the  site  as  a  Single  Page  application,  updated  by  AJAX,  with  heavy  use  of  Telerik  Kendo  MVC  AJAX  UI.  Leveraged  bootstrap  and  responsive  design  to  make  the  site  mobile  friendly.    

Leveraged  ASP.NET  MVC  with  Autofac  Dependency  Injection  to  handled  server-side  communication  and  ASP.NET  identity  to  handle  logging  in  and  security. Developed  Manager  Classes  to  run  the  business  logic,  creating  Unit  Tests  with  MSTest  framework

Developed  repositories  to  access  the  patient  data,  using  a  mixture  of  Entity  Framework  and  JSON  requests  to  internal  RESTful  APIs.  

Created  and  maintained  an  internal  nuget  repository  to  share  code  between  separate  projects  and  solutions.  Created  and  updated  14  nuget  packages  that  can  be  used  in  both  .NET  Framework  and  .NET  Core  projects,  and  that  can  use  EF  or  EF  Core  depending  on  the  target  framework.  These  packages  deal  with  encryption,  logging  through  NLog,  MongoDB  and  Graylog,  verifying  and  creating  JWT  tokens,  creating  EF  contexts  for  our  client  DBs,  retrieving  client  configuration,  caching  through  Redis,  zipping  files,  and  other  shared  utilities.  

Created  a  windows  service  used  to  create  registration  records  based  on  queued  batches  of  client  filters,  during  times  of  low  load  on  our  servers.  Designed  the  windows  service  to  be  able  to  run  concurrently  on  multiple  servers,  potential  writing  on  a  safe  manner  to  the  same  database  from  different  instances.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full  time  position  with  Futrend,  an  ISO  9001:2008  quality  certified,  mid-size  technology  contractor. Worked on several projects for the US government:

     Joined the maintenance team of the 340B Database website https://opanet.hrsa.gov/340B. This is a WebForms  website  used  by  the  Department  of  Health  to  manage  hospitals  and  clinics  associated with  their  340B  program.  Worked  with  a  team  of  business  analysts  and  developers  to  create upgrades for the 340B system, using TFS for source control and team coordination.

     Redesigned  the  dedicated  anthropological  application Bones,  used  by  the  National  Museum  of Natural  History  to  classify  their  collection  of  bones.  Upgraded  the  application  framework  and language,  originally  written  in  Classic  ASP,  to  ASP.NET  MVC  Entity  Framework  and  ASP  .NET Identity.

     Worked  for  the  Smithsonian  Institution  on  their  CDRS application  (Collections  and  Digitization Reporting System), where I took over as the only dedicated analyst and developer.

positions.title: .NET Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Full time contract with the British company Paperstone Ltd, an e-commerce company selling the full range of office supplies online. 
•	Joined the development team and quickly learned their existing Agile based methodology. Immediately joined the effort to upgrade Paperstone website from ASP Webforms to ASP MVC while learning the ASP MVC technology.
•	Learned and adapted to the technologies being used in Paperstone, including: Test driven development with Unit Test and Selenimun Integration tests; continuous build process and releases with Cruise Control; SVN repositories; dependency injection with nInject; Object Relational Mapping with Mindscape Lightspeed; LinQ; html grids with Telerik Controls. 
•	Naturally assumed leadership on Front End Development with CSS3 and jQuery. Lead the work to use responsive design techniques to optimize the website for small screens.
•	Naturally assumed leadership on development for Split Testing, using the third party website Visual Web Optimizer.
•	By individual initiative, further streamlined and automatized the release process by creating an internal tool, reducing time and effort required for Staging and Live releases.
•	Researched and pushed forward development of new AJAX based facet navigation.
•	Contributed other major development jobs for the company, including Admin tools, integration with a 3rd party search and navigation engine and full redesign of the website.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Full time contract with the British company Anteeo Solutions Limited, IT consulting company specialized in offering products for travel agencies. Engaged in the following activities :
•	Development of dynamic web sites for travel agencies, integrating them with the “Travel Management System” tool propriety of Anteeo through a SQL Server database. Delivered a final product in ASP .NET, starting with HTML Web designs and a basic specification from the client in question, maintaining direct communication and receiving feedback from clients throughout the development process.
•	Individual projects: http://www.blueotwo.com/ http://www.seymauritius.com/
•	Collaborative projects include: http://www.golden-holidays.co.uk/   http://www.fabulousexperience.co.uk/ http://www.caribtours.co.uk/

•	Maintenance and upgrades for the teletext type tool ViewData, integrated with ASP .NET

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
•	Full time contract with the multinational company Avanade, IT consulting company subsidiary of Accenture and Microsoft. Immediately placed with top client EADS-Airbus Military. 
•	Developed, along with a team of 20 people, new functionalities for the Content Management Systems used internally by EADS for the management, development, modification and maintenance of military aircraft. These systems use a three-pier structure with ASP .NET 2.0, C# and PL/SQL.

positions.title: Intern Programmer
positions.description: Practice contract of 500 hours, 25 hours per week, coordinated between the Spanish IT consulting company Oesia, former IT Deusto, and the Spanish University UNED. Later extended 200 additional hours. Engaged in the IT activities within the Mobility Department in the main office of Oesia using C# .NET, VB .NET, Sql Server and Java.
